about our technology and approach
Luffy AI are a team of world-leading researchers and engineers working on foundation AI models for physical systems. Our focus is making intelligent control practical for all industrial applications.
Our approach combines evolutionary neuroplastic algorithms with neural networks to create controllers that adapt to ever-changing conditions.

The team brings together expertise in physics, mathematics, control theory and engineering, with strong links to Oxford's research community. We're based at the historic Culham Campus, Oxfordshire in the United Kingdom.

Our work bridges the gap between academic research and industrial application, with developments for motor control, fight control, thermal systems, and process optimization for Physical AI applications. We are partnering with some of the World’s leading industrial organizations to bring truely intelligent devices to the physical World.
